def transform(grid):
    g = [list(r) for r in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    if any(all(v == 1 for v in row) for row in g):
        cuts = [i for i, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 1 for v in row)]
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [h]
        parts = [g[bounds[i]+1:bounds[i+1]] for i in range(4)]
        vertical_sections = True
    else:
        cuts = [j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j] == 1 for i in range(h))]
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [w]
        parts = [[row[bounds[i]+1:bounds[i+1]] for row in g] for i in range(4)]
        vertical_sections = False

    def trim_zero(p):
        cells = [(i, j) for i in range(len(p)) for j in range(len(p[0])) if p[i][j] != 0]
        r0, r1 = min(i for i, j in cells), max(i for i, j in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(j for i, j in cells), max(j for i, j in cells)
        return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in p[r0:r1+1]]

    p = trim_zero(parts[0])
    q = trim_zero(parts[1])
    a, b = parts[2][0][0], parts[3][0][0]
    tile = [[a if v else b for v in row] for row in p]
    ph, pw = len(tile), len(tile[0])

    if vertical_sections:
        # Green columns encode the number of vertical copies.
        copies = len(q[0]) + 1
        out = []
        for k in range(copies):
            out.extend([row[:] for row in tile])
            if k + 1 < copies:
                out.append([b] * pw)
        return out
    else:
        active = [j for j in range(len(q[0])) if any(row[j] for row in q)]
        copies = (max(active) - min(active) + 2) // 2
        sep = [b]
        out = []
        for row in tile:
            line = []
            for k in range(copies):
                if k:
                    line.extend(sep)
                line.extend(row)
            out.append(line)
        return out
